say:2:1524509001:0.text: There you are! I've got all the tools ready. You can start making the salve right away.
say:2:1524509001:0.source_cn: 你们回来了！炼制伤药需要的工具我都已经找出来了，你们准...

say:3:1524509002:0.text: Kal won't hold out much longer... This is a race against time.
say:3:1524509002:0.source_cn: 抓紧时间吧，嘉目前的状况……恐怕拖不了太久。

say:4:1524509003:0.source_cn: 阿娘……求你了，再坚持一下……

Effect: Promotes wound healing by effectively fighting bacteria and reducing inflammation
Preparation: Add <style="highlight">dragonblood vine</style>, <style="highlight">calming yarrow</style>, and <style="highlight">lunar orchid</style>. Simmer until fully dissolved.

性状：淡红色伤药，质地呈黏稠糊状
药效：特效伤药，可有效抗菌消炎，加速伤口愈合
炼制方法：依次加入<style="highlight">龙血藤</style>、<style="highlight">清心蓍草</style>、<style="highlight">月下兰</style>，熬煮至所有药材融化后即可制成。
